prediction.controls: per (reader, pair) as 0020: float16 floor on the pair's texts, identity and scrambled on the pair's first text (rollout for the rollout pair); the rollout pair also carries 0022's far control (the reader's own dump of held-out sequence 40 + i cut to the prompt's length, far_min 0.1) as evaluability insurance, pre-committed by evaluable_under_far = true: a reader whose rollout scrambled misses 0.1 but whose far clears it is EVALUABLE under the far control (unit marked evaluable_under = "far"); a reader that misses both is UNEVALUABLE and its rollout rungs read UNREAD in clauses (ii) and (iii)
descriptive_not_sealed: the per-step distance curve against seed 1's thirty-two values (seed1_reference.rel_delta_all at the kept steps): expected to agree closely and uninformative — Adam's first step is batch-insensitive (seed 1's two-prompt smoke read a step-1 distance within 1.1% of the registered run's); the seed acts on the update's direction, which the rollout KL sees
the reward and entropy trajectories against 0018's (exact-match mean 0.030 over steps 1-8 and 0.148 over 25-32)
rollout over scrambled and over far per lag against 0021's and 0023's (0.037 at g = 1 to 0.77 at g = 16; over far 0.010 to 0.146)
far over scrambled per reader against 0023's 3.6x to 5.8x
the per-lag ratio seed 2 / seed 1 on every text
prediction.halting: the step-0 weights the trainer saves must hash to seed 1's 3779c0b9... before the first optimizer step (the same checkpoint under the same libraries writes the same bytes; a different digest is an environment drift, not a seed, and the sitting stops before it bills the trajectory); a step-1 distance under 1e-6 stops the sitting before the reader run (0017); a floor over 1e-4 halts the reader run (0014); scrambled missed and far cleared = EVALUABLE under far; both missed = UNEVALUABLE, clauses (ii) and (iii) UNREAD at that lag
prediction.kind: replication of the own run (0017, 0018) on a second trainer seed; the clauses are agreement clauses against seed 1's readings, which this seal carries, not 0017's bands re-tested

i_backbone_quadratic.fit: least squares of log median (B1) on log rel_delta_all, per text
i_backbone_quadratic.note: clause (i), second half: the quadratic law along the second trajectory; the key name is the one summarize_reader reads (printed as i)

i_heldout_holds_at_every_lag.statement: clause (i), first half: median (B1) <= 1e-3 (HOLDS_B) at every lag rung on both held-out texts, every rung above 2x its reader's floor; read by the summarizer as i-holds

ii_rollout_replicates_seed1.statement: clause (ii): at every lag the rollout median (B1) lies within a factor of three of seed 1's median at the same lag (reference = seed1_reference.rollout_median_b1), and at g = 1 it is at least 1e-3 (UNRESOLVED or worse: HOLDS_B is lost at the first optimizer step on this seed too); the g = 1 floor is its own half because it is the paper's sentence

iii_rollout_over_heldout.statement: clause (iii): at every lag the rollout median (B1) is at least 1e3x the same reader's median on corpus and on on-path text (seed 1: 1.3e4x to 2.5e4x on corpus, 2.5e4x to 4.5e4x on on-path)

iv_controls_as_0020.statement: clause (iv): every (reader, pair) unit passes its controls under 0014's limits (float16 floor <= 1e-4, identity <= 1e-5, scrambled >= 0.1, far >= 0.1 on the rollout pair) or is EVALUABLE under far as pre-committed; no unit UNEVALUABLE. The readout reports which units were carried by far

rollouts.reused_from: 0017: the step-0 policy's samples; step 0 is the same checkpoint under both seeds, so the same text is read under both trajectories and the comparison is on the trajectory alone

seed1_reference.source: results/ownrun/summary.json sha256 f3b8f00ff6ed2f94... (entry 0018, re-made at home with the readout fix; identical to the pod's on every rung)

prediction.statistic: per rung and text, median over held-out sequences of the mean per-token KL(pi_fresh || pi_stale) over the continuation (B1), nats/token; x = whole-vector relative L2 weight distance of the reader (step g) to the writer (step 0), tools/weight_distance.py

trajectory.tool: tools/own_run.py train, the same arguments as 0017 but --seed 1
